get.description: Return the server status and version.
Return the signed-in user and their active organization, or `null` if they have none yet (for example, while an invitation is pending).
Return the state of an invitation link with its organization and inviter, without signing in. Unknown invitations return the `invalid` state.
Return one page of the spaces that the caller can see.
Return one space by ID or slug.

delete.description: Archive one space and return it. Archiving an archived space returns it unchanged.

get.description: Return one page of the space-members that the caller can see.

delete.description: Archive one space-member and return it. Archiving an archived space-member returns it unchanged.

get.description: Return one page of the sessions that the caller can see.
Return one session by ID or slug.

delete.description: Archive one session and return it. Archiving an archived session returns it unchanged.

post.description: Return the URL of the session’s brain and a short-lived token for the Chat API. Ask again before `expiresAt`.

get.description: Return the models and variants a session with this ID may start with, before it exists. Pass one as `model` to `session.create`. Once the session runs, `model.list` in the Chat API lists them.
get.summary: List models for a new session

post.description: Start a new session in the same space from the session’s messages before `messageId`. The new session links to its source in `forkedFrom`. Retrying with the same `id` returns the fork.
Record that the caller has read the session as it is now. `unread` on the session stays false for them until it changes again.

model.description: The model and variant the session starts with, from `chat.models`. Without it the brain picks one.

Session.ID_1.description: The ID of the new session. The client mints it, so a retry is safe.

forkedFrom.description: The session and message this session was forked before, if it is a fork.

unread.description: Whether the session changed after the caller last read it with `chat.read`. A session the caller never read is unread once it changes after it was created.

SessionMessage.ID_1.description: The fork starts with the source’s messages before this one.

bearer.description: A Better Auth session token, for the CLI and SDK.

cookie.description: The Better Auth session cookie, for browsers. Named `__Secure-better-auth.session_token` over HTTPS.
cookie.name: better-auth.session_token
